description: Defines the SharedFormula class used for handling shared formulas within the XLSX spreadsheet reader component of PhpSpreadsheet.

classes.name: SharedFormula
classes.description: Represents a shared formula in an XLSX spreadsheet, encapsulating the master cell identifier and the formula string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SharedFormula instance with a master cell identifier and a formula.

methods.name: master
methods.description: Returns the master cell identifier of the shared formula.

methods.name: formula
methods.description: Returns the formula string associated with the shared formula.
